verdict.rationale: Paperspace is GPU cloud infrastructure: VMs, Jupyter notebooks, container deployments and ML workflows. It is not a tool-using agent or assistant, so plugging MCP servers into it as a client is a category mismatch for this product type. Nothing in the evidence shows a built-in agent or MCP client mode that would make the axis apply.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
